title: fix(core): date macros resolve on the workspace timezone's day, so an authored view and a panel filter agree on today
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNUh1yiqmon1jHsSAyHEAJF)_

Fixes #29117

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表视图里作者写的日期宏(`{today}`、本周/本月/本季/本年、`N_days_ago` 等)原来按浏览器所在时区的日期解析,现在按工作区设置的时区(`localization.timezone`)的日期解析,和服务器解析筛选面板里同一个宏的时区一致。工作区时区还没加载到时仍用浏览器的日期;`{now}`、`N_hours_ago` 这类时刻宏不受影响。
- **为什么改**:实测:工作区设为奥克兰、浏览器在纽约时,视图「今天成交」查的是 11-02,读者在筛选面板选的「今天」查的是 11-03;两者叠在同一个列表上,一次请求带着两个日期,结果为空。
- **风险与回滚**:浏览器和工作区在同一天时行为不变(对照组实测一致)。所有经 `resolveDateMacros` 解析日期宏的界面(看板、日历、仪表盘、图表、对比上期等)也随之改按工作区日期。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts` 的 `calendarDayIn` 与 `today` 的使用处;其次 `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` 里新增的 `workspaceTimeZone` 依赖。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/date-macros.workspaceZone-29117.test.ts`,预期 8 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts` | The calendar tokens (`today`, `yesterday`, `tomorrow`, the week, month, quarter and year bounds, `N_days` / `N_weeks` / `N_months` / `N_years`) are computed from the calendar day `now` falls on in `getDisplayTimeZone()`: the display zone `LocalizationProvider` declares from the served `localization.timezone`, which is the zone the server resolves an unresolved macro in. A new private `calendarDayIn` reads that day with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` and hands the existing local arithmetic a local `Date` at noon of it. The instant tokens (`now`, `N_minutes`, `N_hours`) keep reading `now`. With no zone declared the function reads `now` exactly as before. The signature `resolveDateMacros(filter, now?)` is unchanged. |
| `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx` | Reads `useLocalization().timezone` and adds it to `renderListView`'s dependencies, so a view's authored filter is resolved again when the workspace zone arrives after the first render. `isSameOptionsValue` keeps the filter's identity when the day does not change. |
| `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/date-macros.workspaceZone-29117.test.ts` (new) | Fake timers at fixed instants where the declared zone and the UTC process clock are on different days, in both orders (Pacific/Auckland ahead, America/New_York behind). It covers `{today}` and its neighbours, the week bounds at a Sunday-to-Monday boundary, the month, quarter and year bounds at a year boundary, the list path through `resolveFilterPlaceholders`, instant tokens unchanged, and a no-zone control that also checks clearing the zone. |
| `.changeset/29117-date-macros-workspace-zone.md` | `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. |

## Why

Phase 1 of the card measured the two clocks live on main `f2bf2938` (record: the card thread's run record). The setup was app-crm `--fresh`, the console on source, Playwright with an emulated browser zone and the real clock at 12:00Z (New York on Nov 2, Auckland on Nov 3). Two `closed_won` opportunities closed on 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03. The authored list view had `close_date between ['{today}', '{today}']`, and the reader's panel had Expected Close, Between, Today.

- Workspace Auckland, browser New York: the authored view sent `["2026-11-02","2026-11-02"]` and got the 11-02 row. The panel sent `["{today}","{today}"]` and the server answered the 11-03 row. With the panel rule on the authored view, one request carried both days and matched 0 rows.
- The reverse pair flipped. Same-zone controls agreed in both zones.
- The page already had the workspace zone (`GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` answered Auckland), but `resolveDateMacros` never read one.

The seat's ruling on the card: the workspace timezone decides, as the console's timezone prompt promises and as the server already resolves. The browser clock serves only when no workspace zone is known.

## Tests

- New file: 8 cases, green. Ablation, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with an on-disk anchor count and a restore verified against HEAD's blob:
  - Cutting the zone read (`calendarDayIn(now, getDisplayTimeZone() && undefined)`) turns 7 cases red: every zone case and the no-zone control's cleared-zone leg. The instant-token case and the existing `date-macros.test.ts` (8 cases) stay green.
  - Moving `{now}` onto the calendar day (`now: () => today.toISOString()`) turns the instant-token case red, 1 failed / 7 passed.
- app-shell: the 126 test files that name `ObjectView` or `objectViewListRenderer`, in three locked batches (numbers under Verification). The rest of app-shell is left to CI's Test UI.

## Acceptance notes

- **The other callers get the fix through `resolveDateMacros` with no edit of their own**: `useResolvedFilter` (data-list, elements, record-picker, ObjectCalendar, ObjectGantt, ObjectKanban, ObjectMap, ObjectTimeline, ObjectTree, ObjectGallery, RelatedList, LineItemsPanel), `ObjectDataPage`'s URL `filter[...]` triples, `useOpenRecordList`, plugin-grid `objectGridQuery`, plugin-view `ObjectView`, plugin-charts `ObjectChart`, plugin-dashboard `DatasetWidget` / `ObjectDataTable` / `ObjectMetricWidget` / `ObjectPivotTable`, plugin-detail `useRelatedCounts`, `shiftFilterByCompareTo` (compare-to) and plugin-calendar's `resolveInitialDateMacro`. **Out of scope:** only the list's authored filter re-resolves when the zone arrives late. Those callers resolve with whatever zone is declared when they render, and none re-renders on the zone's arrival. In the live run the zone had landed before the list's first query.
- `calendarDayIn` repeats `date-display.ts`'s private `dayIn` reading (an `Intl` parts lookup per zone) rather than exporting it, which would widen `@object-ui/core`'s published entry.
- No `filter-tokens.ts` change: `resolveFilterPlaceholders` passes `now` through, and the zone is read inside `resolveDateMacros`.

## Verification

Final head `86b71aeb` (`main` `eef116e4` merged in). Local runs, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/`: 232 files, 4288 passed / 27 skipped.
- app-shell, the 126 files naming `ObjectView` or `objectViewListRenderer`: 38 + 44 + 44 files, 364 + 358 + 362 tests passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 34 families for this diff. All 34 ran with exit 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (under the lock) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files passed, 2 skipped). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- eslint on the two touched source files: 0 errors (warnings only, all on lines this diff does not touch).

The first head `530d6f50` (before the main merge) ran the same set green, and the ablations above ran there.

**Live re-measure after the fix** (head `530d6f50`, app-crm `--fresh` + the console on source, Playwright, real clock 13:16Z, which is Nov 2 08:16 in New York and Nov 3 02:16 in Auckland; the panel leg on `main`'s own FilterBuilder):

| workspace | browser | leg | filter sent | rows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pacific/Auckland | America/New_York | authored | `[["close_date","between",["2026-11-03","2026-11-03"]]]` | 1: the 11-03 row (was 11-02 before the fix) |
| Pacific/Auckland | America/New_York | panel | `["close_date","between",["{today}","{today}"]]` | 1: the 11-03 row |
| Pacific/Auckland | America/New_York | panel on the authored view | `["and",[["close_date","between",["2026-11-03","2026-11-03"]]],["close_date","between",["{today}","{today}"]]]` | 1: the 11-03 row (was 0 before the fix) |
| America/New_York | Pacific/Auckland | authored | `[…["2026-11-02","2026-11-02"]]` | 1: the 11-02 row |
| America/New_York | Pacific/Auckland | panel | `[…["{today}","{today}"]]` | 1: the 11-02 row |
| America/New_York | America/New_York (control) | authored | `[…["2026-11-02","2026-11-02"]]` | 1: the 11-02 row |

The authored view was a throwaway `closing_today` listView added to app-crm for the run and removed afterwards; nothing of it is in this diff.
